items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Do you know Matt Murray? Who? Matt Murray. He's a drummer.

ctx.x: Ask me if you knew Matt Murray.
Do you know Matt Murray? Who? Matt Murray. He's a drummer. Matt Murray? Murray was a drummer. Matt Murray. You know what I mean?
He used a banjo head for a snare. Oh, yeah.
